selectedPreliminaryProfile.assumptionPolicy: The manufacturer system, exact SKU, 2 m section, 24 m transport package and compatible 40x25 accessory family are bound to official IEK documents. Installed section and straight-joint demand are calculated from the mounted route, never from transport-pack quantity; changing a purchase package may change order and remainder but cannot add installation joints. Reserve, route continuity, support spacing, fastening package, productivity, substrate, height and logistics are visible replaceable planning assumptions. Corner, tee and open-end counts are never inferred from route length and remain visible dependent clarifications.

engineeringLimitations: Transport packaging is procurement only. Installed section count is based on route length and section length, so spare sections do not receive fictitious straight connectors.
The 40x25 system is a selected preliminary manufacturer profile; cable fill, conductor system, fire classification and route environment must be checked before purchase.
Fastener type and capacity must be replaced after the actual substrate and loading are known; the preliminary solid-masonry profile is not structural approval.
Cable, cable pulling, terminations, devices, penetrations, fire stopping and energization are excluded from this bounded installation technology.
The КРЕРм source is not used to invent a universal labor or machine productivity; planning productivities remain visible and editable.
Unknown prices stay null and do not convert to zero.
